title: Reads vs Time
description: Number of reads detected through the run; shows whether sequencing output is still increasing.

title: Cumulative Reads (log)
description: Cumulative read growth on a log scale; useful when early and late rounds differ greatly in read depth.

title: Read Quality (violin)
description: Distribution of read quality scores after basecalling and target filtering; wider regions contain more reads.

title: Read Length (violin)
description: Distribution of read lengths; helps identify whether reads match the expected marker-size range.

title: Read Density
description: Read-length density curve; peaks show the most common sequence lengths in the run.

title: Reads per Barcode
description: Reads assigned to each demultiplexing barcode; useful for checking sample balance and barcode failures.

title: Reads per Sample
description: Reads assigned to each reported sample or tracked group after demultiplexing.

title: Reads per Sample (log)
description: Same sample read counts on a log scale; highlights low-count samples when counts vary widely.

title: OTU Taxonomy Over Time
description: Assigned and unassigned OTUs by marker across rounds; shows how taxonomic evidence accumulates.

title: Frozen OTU Taxonomy Over Time
description: Stable OTUs carried forward across rounds, grouped by marker and assignment status.

title: Consensus Taxonomy Over Time
description: Consensus sequences emitted across rounds, grouped by marker and assignment status.

title: Consolidated Consensus Taxonomy Over Time
description: Stable consensus sequences carried forward across rounds, grouped by marker and assignment status.

title: OTU Species Treemap (COI)
description: COI species-level OTU composition; larger boxes indicate more OTU/read support depending on the plot weight.

title: OTU Species Treemap (ITS2)
description: ITS2 species-level OTU composition; larger boxes indicate more OTU/read support depending on the plot weight.

title: OTU Genus Treemap (COI)
description: COI genus-level OTU composition; useful when species-level resolution is uncertain.

title: OTU Genus Treemap (ITS2)
description: ITS2 genus-level OTU composition; useful when species-level resolution is uncertain.

title: OTU Fan Cladogram (COI)
description: COI taxonomic tree weighted by reads in OTUs; shows how OTU evidence is distributed across lineages.

title: OTU Fan Cladogram (ITS2)
description: ITS2 taxonomic tree weighted by reads in OTUs; shows how OTU evidence is distributed across lineages.

title: Consensus Species Treemap (COI)
description: COI species-level composition based on emitted consensus sequences.

title: Consensus Species Treemap (ITS2)
description: ITS2 species-level composition based on emitted consensus sequences.

title: Consensus Genus Treemap (COI)
description: COI genus-level composition based on emitted consensus sequences.

title: Consensus Genus Treemap (ITS2)
description: ITS2 genus-level composition based on emitted consensus sequences.

title: Consensus Fan Cladogram (COI)
description: COI taxonomic tree weighted by consensus count; shows representative sequence evidence across lineages.

title: Consensus Fan Cladogram (ITS2)
description: ITS2 taxonomic tree weighted by consensus count; shows representative sequence evidence across lineages.
